subject: general
question: Dena Bank and Vijaya Bank have recently merged with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank of Baroda**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **April 2019**, **Dena Bank** and **Vijaya Bank** merged with **Bank of Baroda** as part of the Indian government’s initiative to consolidate public sector banks to create stronger, more competitive entities.
 
• This merger made Bank of Baroda the **third-largest public sector bank** in India by assets, after the State Bank of India and Punjab National Bank.
 
• The merger aimed to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen the bank's financial position.
 
• Customers of Dena Bank and Vijaya Bank were integrated into Bank of Baroda, including branches, services, and accounts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bank of India**: Bank of India is a public sector bank but was not part of this specific merger.
 
• **Punjab National Bank**: While Punjab National Bank merged with **Oriental Bank of Commerce** and **United Bank of India** in 2020, it was not involved in the merger with Dena and Vijaya Banks.
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI)**: SBI, India’s largest public sector bank, has undergone its own series of consolidations, including the merger with its five associate banks in 2017, but was not involved in the Dena Bank and Vijaya Bank merger.
